model_organism.citation: Effects of ATF2/TSC1 on epilepsy by modulating the microphages polarization of microglia. (PMID: 40595935)
phenotypes: Reduced M1 polarization of microglia in kainic acid-induced epilepsy model
Relieved neuroinflammation in epilepsy mouse model

model_organism.citation: OGT-Mediated O-GlcNAcylation of ATF2 Protects Against Sepsis-Associated Encephalopathy by Inhibiting Microglial Pyroptosis. (PMID: 40411666)
phenotypes: Impaired cognitive function in healthy mice
Accelerated progression in sepsis-associated encephalopathy (SAE) mice

model_organism.citation: Lack of p38 activation in T cells increases IL-35 and protects against obesity by promoting thermogenesis. (PMID: 38730210)
phenotypes: Reduced CD8+ T cell infiltration in adipose tissue

model_organism.citation: Annexin A3 Represses Endothelial Permeability and Inflammation During Sepsis via Actin Cytoskeleton Modulation. (PMID: 40151887)
phenotypes: Upregulated E-selectin (CD62E) expression through ATF2 phosphorylation

model_organism.citation: SIRT6 Lysine-Demyristoylates ATF2 to Ameliorate Vascular Injury via PRKCD/VE-Cadherin Pathway Regulating Vascular Endothelial Barrier. (PMID: 40810740)
Inhibition of long noncoding RNA HIF1A-AS2 confers protection against atherosclerosis via ATF2 downregulation. (PMID: 33133688)
phenotypes: Decreased pro-inflammatory factor levels (TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6)
Decreased adhesion molecule expression (VCAM-1, ICAM-1, MCP-1)
Reduced atherosclerotic lesion formation in ApoE-/- mice

model_organism.citation: ASHG 2010 - A53T-alpha-synuclein overexpression impairs dopamine signaling and striatal synaptic plasticity in old mice. (S. Gispert Sanchez et al.)
phenotypes: Altered dopamine levels correlated with SNCA expression
Reduced expression of DA-inducible genes including Atf2
Progressive and genotype-dependent reduction in postsynaptic DA response
Absent long-term depression (LTD) in corticostriatal slices

biological.citation: Increased ATF2 expression predicts poor prognosis and inhibits sorafenib-induced ferroptosis in gastric cancer (PMID: 36473315)
biological.summary: ATF2 is significantly upregulated in gastric cancer tissues and acts as a transcriptional regulator of HSPH1, which stabilizes SLC7A11 (cystine/glutamate transporter) to inhibit ferroptosis. ATF2 knockdown promotes sorafenib-induced ferroptosis while overexpression inhibits it, and ATF2 knockdown enhances sorafenib sensitivity in tumor xenografts.
biological.sample_size: gastric cancer cell lines and tumor xenograft model

biological.citation: Hepatocyte-derived MASP1-enriched small extracellular vesicles activate HSCs to promote liver fibrosis (PMID: 35849032)
biological.summary: ATF2 functions as a downstream transcription factor in the p38 MAPK/ATF2 signaling pathway activated by MASP1, which promotes hepatic stellate cell activation and liver fibrogenesis. This represents ATF2's role in stress-responsive MAPK signaling.
biological.sample_size: primary hepatocytes, HSCs, and mouse models of liver fibrosis

biological.citation: Inflammatory signaling sensitizes Piezo1 mechanotransduction in articular chondrocytes as a pathogenic feed-forward mechanism in osteoarthritis (PMID: 33758095)
biological.summary: ATF2 is a transcription factor required for IL-1α-induced upregulation of Piezo1 in chondrocytes, working downstream of p38 MAP-kinase signaling. CREBP1 (ATF2/CREBP1) directly binds the proximal PIEZO1 gene promoter to regulate its expression in osteoarthritis pathogenesis.
biological.sample_size: primary porcine chondrocytes and human osteoarthritic cartilage

biological.citation: ANXA3-Rich Exosomes Derived from Tumor-Associated Macrophages Regulate Ferroptosis and Lymphatic Metastasis of Laryngeal Squamous Cell Carcinoma (PMID: 38393971)
biological.summary: ATF2 acts as a transcription factor regulating CHAC1 expression to inhibit ferroptosis in laryngeal cancer cells. ANXA3 in exosomes inhibits ATF2 ubiquitination, stabilizing ATF2 protein and promoting its transcriptional activity in the ferroptosis-inhibitory pathway.
biological.sample_size: laryngeal cancer cell lines and tumor-associated macrophages

biological.citation: MG53 protects against septic cardiac dysfunction by ubiquitinating ATF2 (PMID: 40107350)
biological.summary: MG53 directly ubiquitinates ATF2, reducing its transcriptional activity and inhibiting TLR4 expression in septic cardiac dysfunction. ATF2 is identified as an essential transcriptional factor for TLR4 expression, and its ubiquitination-mediated degradation protects cardiac function.
biological.sample_size: C57BL/6J mice with LPS-induced septic cardiomyopathy

biological.citation: ATF2, a paradigm of the multifaceted regulation of transcription factors in biology and disease (PMID: 28212892)
biological.summary: Comprehensive review establishing ATF2 as a transcription factor with multiple levels of regulation including transcriptional, post-transcriptional, and post-translational mechanisms. ATF2 integrates extracellular and intracellular signals through phosphorylation by JNK/p38 and ATM/ATR kinases.

biological.citation: CENPT prevents renal cell carcinoma against ferroptosis by enhancing the synthesis of glutathione (PMID: 40651948)
biological.summary: ATF2 acts as a transcription factor that increases CENPT expression in response to elevated glutathione (GSH) levels, forming a CENPT-GCLC-GSH feedback loop that inhibits ferroptosis in renal cell carcinoma.

biological.citation: ATF2: a transcription factor that elicits oncogenic or tumor suppressor activities (PMID: 18677098)
biological.summary: ATF2 functions as both a transcription factor and DNA damage response protein with tissue- and tumor-specific roles. Altered ATF2 expression and subcellular localization are associated with tumor stage and prognosis, with oncogenic activity in melanoma but tumor suppressor function in cooperation with mutated oncogenes in other contexts.

biological.citation: MAP4K4 and WT1 mediate SOX6-induced cellular senescence by synergistically activating the ATF2-TGFβ2-Smad2/3 signaling pathway in cervical cancer (PMID: 38383842)
biological.summary: ATF2 functions as a transcription factor downstream of MAP4K4-MAPK (JNK/ERK/p38) and WT1 signaling to activate TGFB2 gene expression and promote cellular senescence in cervical cancer. ATF2 integrates signals from multiple kinase pathways to regulate TGFβ2-mediated senescence.

biological.citation: ASHG 2022 - Low CD2 expression in sentinel lymph nodes of early breast cancer patients is associated with postoperative tumor recurrence or metastasis (S. Kang, H. Lee, J-H. Kim, T. Park)
biological.summary: ATF2 expression is significantly decreased in sentinel lymph nodes of early breast cancer patients with locoregional recurrence or distant metastasis compared to those without recurrence, suggesting ATF2 as a prognostic marker for breast cancer recurrence.
biological.sample_size: 119 cases (54 SLNs with recurrence, 65 without recurrence)
